reason: Mixed-unit math on a reference ({breakpoints.x}-1px): the resolver writes `var(--…)-1px`, which is invalid CSS; render writes `calc(var(--…) - 1px)`. Any token of that shape, not only content.maxWidth.
A value that is no valid CSS (empty cubic-bezier) breaks render's build with path and theme instead of being written; the resolver writes `cubic-bezier([object Object], …)`.
